tasks.label: MSVC: Build Active C++ File
tasks.command: if not exist "build" mkdir "build" && call "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\18\Community\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvars64.bat" >nul && cl.exe /Zi /FS /EHsc /nologo /Fo"build\\" /Fd"build\\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.pdb" /Fe"build\\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe" "${file}" && echo BUILD SUCCESSFUL
